name: Density
purpose: Smooth sine-shaped saturation that fattens and pushes a sound forward; negative settings thin it and push it back. A highpass keeps the fattening out of the lows.
avoid_for: material that must stay completely untouched
notes: All Airwindows parameters are 0..1; Density's own display is (A*5)-1, so 0.2 is 0.
Raising Density increases level: use Out Level or a later module to rebalance.
CPU: 0.19% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.

expose.ai_hint: 0.2 is neutral. 0.4 mild fattening, 0.6 fat and forward, 1.0 extreme. Below 0.2 thins the sound and pushes it back. Try 0.3-0.5 on vocals.
Highpass on the added density only. 0 leaves the lows fattened too; raise it (0.3-0.6) so a vocal or full-range sound gets thickness without extra low-end build up.
Output level. 1.0 is unity; lower it if the density makes the sound louder.
Dry/wet. 1.0 is fully processed; 0.4-0.7 blends in the original for parallel-style thickening.
